tickets.title: Prepare owner draw and tax set-aside worksheet
tickets.text: Provide Darian Nettlewhisk a planning worksheet that separates household draws, tax set-asides, and business operating reserves for Copper Firefly Studio LLC, because retainer income and workshop payments will not arrive evenly. Reference the $9,000 per month retainers and $18,000 of workshop deposits.

tickets.title: Compare self-employed retirement plan options
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of retirement plan structures that could fit Copper Firefly Studio LLC alongside Liora Nettlewhisk's ongoing salary deferrals and the household cash reserve target, for Darian Nettlewhisk's planned planning review with Paper Otter Tax.

tickets.title: Address business liability and disability coverage
tickets.text: Address coverage items for Darian Nettlewhisk: obtaining a professional liability policy for Copper Firefly Studio LLC, which has none on file, and replacing disability coverage that was tied to his prior employer benefits at Pocket Lantern Analytics.
